title: Apply administrator-approved project limits to API keys and console sessions

endpoints.before: Limit requests were saved without a dashboard approval action; new keys inherited only the project tier and console sessions ignored custom project RPM.
endpoints.after: After explicit administrator approval, existing and future project keys inherit the approved RPM. Console sessions use the current project custom RPM on each request. Key caches refresh within five minutes; operation caps and quota counters are unchanged. Projects without an approved change retain their existing limits.
